native_result.HypoA: Symbolic capital components such as house size, the number of daggers, and hatchets/swords are characterized by negative values on the first principal component (PC1) and exhibit a wide distribution of values on the second principal component (PC2). This Principal component analysis (PCA) is on the forms of capital. The values of the individual elements of the forms of capital form the attributes.
native_result.HypoB: In the PCA of forms of capital analyzed in hundred-year time slices, symbolic capital components (house size, daggers, and hatchets/swords) are characterized on PC1 by consistent values of the same sign (moderate-to-high loadings between 0.23 and 0.30), whereas across PC2 they are distributed with hatchets/swords and daggers near zero (0.05-0.07) and house size exhibiting a significantly larger positive loading (~0.33-0.36), distinguishing mobile martial prestige goods from domestic architecture.

Evaluated loadings, relative distributions, and domain interpretations for symbolic capital components.
